name: DoAr 21

images.note: Marginal disk just outside coronagraph + bright SE filament proceeding counterclockwise to a northern knot; no mm counterpart (Cieza 2019 non-detection) - scattered light only

paper.title: Disks Around T Tauri Stars with SPHERE (DARTTS-S). II. Twenty-one new polarimetric images of young stellar disks

notes: Weak-lined T Tauri star in Ophiuchus; scattered-light disk + filament detected in DARTTS-S II (Garufi et al. 2020); no mm counterpart (ODISEA non-detection).
